scope: Actual pure semantic planner/engine snapshot and actual mixer with controlled DOM+pipeline; no GPU/browser/File pixel proof.

checks.name: Engine semantic snapshot reads frozen metadata without touching audio graph collaborators
Duplicate destination banks remain ordered distinct slots and Master is represented only once
Unsupported routes/names never silently become an active target
Duplicate frame IDs cannot duplicate history capture
Real Echo history taps use timestamps while timing edits retain captured input
Source and transport discontinuities cannot resurrect any old captured timestamp
Recreating raw output during readyState2 seek waits without poisoning the pipeline
Resize during seek resamples prior decoded raw and defers presentation commit until valid decode
